product_overview: HeatRoute is a climate-tech mobility app that compares real road route options between two locations and recommends the one with lower heat exposure. It uses live routing, geocoding, and FortyGuard temperature intelligence to produce a transparent Heat Exposure Score and route explanation.
core_goals: Help users choose between real road routes based on heat exposure rather than shortest distance alone.
Use server-side integration with FortyGuard to analyze candidate route corridors with real temperature intelligence.
Provide a clear, polished map-based UI with route comparison, scoring, and a recommendation.
Support safe, validated analysis requests for supported U.S. locations, with graceful handling of unsupported regions and API errors.

features.name: Location Search and Geocoding
features.description: Lets users enter or select origin and destination locations, then resolves them into usable coordinates for route analysis.
user_flows: GET /api/geocode?query=Huntsville, AL with a valid location query -> Receive 200 with matching location suggestions and coordinates -> User selects a suggested location -> Coordinates are used for route analysis
GET /api/geocode?query=12345! with an invalid query -> Receive 400 or 200 with no usable results -> Show a validation or no-results message to the user

features.name: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine
features.description: Builds candidate road routes, samples route corridors, submits them to FortyGuard, and ranks routes by heat exposure.
user_flows: POST /api/analyze with valid origin and destination coordinates in supported Alabama, USA locations -> Receive 200 with ranked route candidates, heat statistics, and recommendation -> Display the recommended route, route cards, and map overlays

POST /api/analyze with unsupported or invalid coordinates -> Receive 400 or 422 with a controlled error such as unsupported region or invalid input -> Show a safe error message without fabricating heat results

POST /api/analyze with a request that cannot produce a route or exceeds analysis constraints -> Receive 4xx/5xx controlled failure response -> Present a route-not-found or analysis-limit error to the user

features.name: Service Health Check
features.description: Provides a lightweight endpoint to confirm the server is running and ready to process requests.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with healthy status -> Frontend or monitoring confirms the service is available
GET /api/health when the service is degraded -> Receive non-200 or unhealthy payload -> Display or log that the backend is temporarily unavailable

features.name: Route Analysis and Thermal Decision Engine
features.description: Computes relative heat exposure for candidate road routes using FortyGuard LTM Single-Hour Heatmap

endpoints.description: Analyzes route candidates, fetches FortyGuard microclimate stats, and ranks routes
Autocompletes location search queries using Nominatim
